name: Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
summary: Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A. engages in the distribution of electricity in the state of Pará, Brazil. It serves residential, industrial, commercial, rural, public authority, public lighting service, and public service customers. The company was formerly known as Centrais Elétricas do Pará S.A. and changed its name to Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A. in December 2019. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Belém, Brazil. Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Equatorial Energia Distribuição S.A.
